decisions.CLINICALTRIALS_PROPOSED_CADENCE: every 24 h, incremental (since + pageToken), <= 100 studies per run, backlog continues next run
decisions.EUROSTAT_PROPOSED_CADENCE: weekly tiny change check; full ingest only when dataset updated or latest period changes
decisions.SCHEDULER_TOPOLOGY: A: one dedicated cron */5 dispatching ONE bounded invocation of the shared runner for the due source, with a global lease guard (B's invariant); no new table
decisions.GLOBAL_SERIALIZATION_DESIGN: single guarded lease statement (NOT EXISTS any other unexpired lease) as the only claim path for scheduler, operator route and every profile; MAX_ACTIVE_RUNS 1; one invocation per tick; lease-deadline stop; V1/OECD controls 0 while recurring is on; post-run duplicate-label invariant
decisions.SCHEMA_CHANGE_REQUIRED_FOR_STEADY_STATE: YES (one additive audit-events migration; a window index only if measured necessary)
decisions.INCREMENTAL_DERIVE: affected concepts only, both families per concept, per-run supportChanges (<= 20 ids), stale fast windows marked STALE_FAST_WINDOW and refreshed by a bounded aging sweep (<= 20 concepts per tick)
decisions.RETENTION_POLICY_READY: YES (frozen; compaction not needed before first activation)

allowed_transitions.by: owner; scheduler only for a transient-circuit pause after a successful cooldown probe
scheduler on legal/access, schema drift, integrity, governance

clinicaltrials.basis: LIVE V1 canary 9730 statements / 100 studies; ESTIMATE until burn-in

eurostat.basis: LIVE canary max 212, CPU max 264 ms, wall max 7342 ms, 0 terminations

global.cpu_thresholds_status: UNVERIFIED, 4x the observed max, recalibrate from burn-in

stages.name: BURN_IN: both sources, incremental multi-family derive, promotion eligibility recorded, candidates/snapshots/reviews OFF
stages.minimum: >= 14 consecutive days, >= 10 CT runs, >= 2 Eurostat checks

stages.name: candidate persistence ON for human review (after R11 + R12)

gates.title: Source activation policy
gates.current: canary controls and per-reader enable only
gates.required_design: per-source states DISABLED/BURN_IN/ACTIVE/PAUSED/BLOCKED + global switch + env switch; owner-only activation
gates.evidence: REPO canary controls; LIVE two manual canaries

gates.title: Source-specific cadence
gates.required_design: CT 24 h incremental; Eurostat weekly change check
gates.evidence: REPO buildStudiesUrl since/pageToken; LIVE costs; volume UNVERIFIED

gates.title: Scheduler topology
gates.current: no DOSSIER scheduler; GCOS per-minute cron with slot rotation
gates.required_design: dedicated */5 cron, one bounded invocation per tick, state derived from run tables

gates.title: Cross-family/global run serialization
gates.current: V2 lease excludes other leases; V1 path independent
gates.required_design: one guarded claim statement for every path; one active run; deadline stop; post-run invariant; no schema change
gates.evidence: LOCAL concurrency tests; D1 serial writes documented, drill in burn-in

gates.title: Lease/checkpoint/resume
gates.required_design: unified per-source contract; FAILED_NO_STATE retry vs FAILED_PARTIAL blocked

gates.title: Retry/backoff/circuit breaker
gates.required_design: 7 retry classes, backoff ladder, circuit at 5 failures, BLOCKED on integrity/governance

gates.title: Source health / alerting
gates.required_design: derived per-source health, 4 severities, structured events, readiness block
gates.activation_blocker: MUST_IMPLEMENT_BEFORE_BURN_IN (minimal); thresholds recalibrated before steady state

gates.title: Incremental aggregation / convergence
gates.required_design: supportChanges, stale fast-window handling, aging sweep
gates.evidence: LIVE derive of 91 of 486 concepts; aggregate windows dated by derive day

gates.title: Revision + current-provenance correctness
gates.required_design: derive and read paths use only effective observations
gates.activation_blocker: DEFERRED_NON_BLOCKING (production proof of a natural revision)

gates.title: Candidate snapshot provenance
gates.required_design: effective-evidence selection, family_support_state, validateSnapshotProvenance, immutability tests

gates.title: Human review / promotion governance
gates.required_design: OPS review endpoint, append-only, no config mutation, record-only eligibility in burn-in

gates.title: Retention / storage-growth policy
gates.required_design: per-table policy and thresholds frozen; compaction in bounded batches
gates.evidence: REPO triggers (immutable tables), D1 size 12.98 MB; row sizes UNVERIFIED

gates.title: Operational observability
gates.required_design: bounded ops read model: summary, runs, source health, changes, alerts

gates.title: Secret/operator security
gates.required_design: owner reset, read/write token split, redaction, audit table, rotation policy
gates.activation_blocker: token reset and split MUST_IMPLEMENT_BEFORE_BURN_IN; audit table MUST_IMPLEMENT_BEFORE_STEADY_STATE
gates.evidence: LIVE canary hygiene; REPO routes use one OPS_TOKEN

gates.title: Rollback / shutdown
gates.required_design: source-local pause and global disable semantics

gates.title: Activation sequence / burn-in
gates.required_design: stages 0-3 with minimums, gates, rollback, owner approvals

MUST_IMPLEMENT_BEFORE_BURN_IN: scheduler tick + dedicated cron + per-source due/backoff/circuit
shared global lease path; V1-profile refusal while recurring is on
minimal ops read model, structured events, readiness block
read/write token split and owner token reset
MUST_IMPLEMENT_BEFORE_CANDIDATE_PERSISTE: stale fast-window handling and aging sweep (R09)
DEFERRED_NON_BLOCKING: production proof of a natural Eurostat revision
